newsitem.title: USA: ATT in talks on Olympics sponsorship.
newsitem.headline: ATT in talks on Olympics sponsorship.

text.p: AT&T Corp said Tuesday it was in talks with the U.S. Olympic Committee (USOC) and television network NBC Inc to be a long-term sponsor and advertiser.
"We have nothing to announce yet," a spokesman said. "We're in negotiations, but we have nothing firm."
The spokesman said the telephone giant was considering a long-term sponsorship through the 2008 games.
"What we've learned about the Olympics is: We do best if we view it as a long-term proposition."
AT&T has been an Olympics sponsor since 1984.
General Electric Co's NBC has rights to broadcast the games through 2008, and, along with the USOC, has reportedly sealed a major deal with General Motors Corp as sole automotive sponsor.
